text: A busy phone line should not feel like a queue to nowhere. CCaaS is a cloud contact centre service that brings call queues, routing, recording and live reports into one place, with agents working from the office, from home or both. Blake Telecom sets it up and tests it before it reaches you. Read our CCaaS guide, or call us on 01325 647000 to talk it through.

Your team is out and about, so their phones should work as hard as they do. Blake Telecom supplies business mobiles and SIMs that we look after alongside your office phone system, so you have one supplier to call if anything needs attention. Talk to us about what your team needs on the road.

Does your team already live in Microsoft Teams? You can take phone calls there too. Blake Telecom connects your business number to Teams, so staff use one app for chat, meetings and calls while customers keep ringing the number they know. Get in touch to see how it would fit the way you work.

When a call comes in, who should answer it? With automatic call distribution, you decide. Instead of every phone ringing at once, callers join a queue and are passed on by rules you choose: the agent who has been free longest, the colleague with the right skills, or an important customer moved to the front of the line. The rules can change with the time of day. Read our guide to ACD, or call us on 01325 647000.
